compiled_state.title: [session-orchestrator]: post-compact session lacks PR-ownership memory -> orchestrator closes other sessions' PRs as 'mystery'
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
A session orchestrator was observed attempting to close another session's PR because it had no memory the PR existed and treated it as a 'mystery' to be cleaned up. The orchestrator's logic for deciding whether to act on a PR did not distinguish between (a) PRs it had created itself but forgotten due to context compaction, (b) PRs it had created itself and remembers, and (c) PRs created by entirely different sessions. The result is destructive cross-session interference: one session closes another's in-flight work.

## Expected Behavior
A session must be able to: (1) recognize PRs it owns (its own session's prior work) even after an auto-compact that wipes conversation memory, AND (2) recognize PRs it does NOT own (other sessions' PRs) and leave them strictly alone — no close, no comment that implies authority, no merge, no force-push. The default for any PR whose ownership cannot be positively established as belonging to this session must be hands-off.

## Actual Behavior
Post-compact session encountered a PR it had no memory of, classified it as a 'mystery' (assumed orphaned/abandoned), and attempted to close it. Other-session ownership was not detected. No persistent ownership marker exists today linking PRs to the session that created them in a way that survives compaction.

## Surface analysis (multi-subsystem)
This is a cross-cutting concern touching at least:
- PR creation surface (.claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh and any gh pr create call site) — needs to stamp a session-identifying marker on PR body/branch/labels
- Session identity surface — needs a stable session ID that survives compaction (worktree path? branch name? a sentinel file in .claude/artifacts/?)
- PR action surface (end-session, debug-everything cleanup loops, retro skill, any orchestrator that lists or acts on PRs) — needs an ownership check before destructive actions
- CLAUDE.md / skill rules — needs a Critical Rule on the order of 'never close/modify a PR your session did not create unless explicitly user-authorized'
- post-compact resume detection — when a session resumes from compaction, the ownership marker must be discoverable from durable state (not conversation memory)

comments.body:
Investigation RESULT (INTERMEDIATE tier, opus): all 4 claims CONFIRMED with file:line evidence.

ROOT_CAUSE: Sessions creating PRs stamp no session-identifying marker (merge-to-main-pr.sh:428-429 produces body 'Auto-generated PR for branch ...' with no trailer). Downstream destructive call sites (merge-to-main-pr.sh:437/549/1295, debug-everything/SKILL.md:1175, phase-10-merge-verify.md:51, end-session/SKILL.md:242) all resolve target PR purely by 'gh pr list --head $(git branch --show-current)' with no ownership check. CLAUDE_SESSION_ID env var exists (consumed only by suggestion-record.sh:127) but is not propagated to PR metadata; SPRINT_SESSION_ID is branch-derived and collapses on the same surface as the bug. No CLAUDE.md rule prohibits destructive actions on PRs the current session did not create.

PROPOSED FIX (for brainstorm to evaluate): stamp Session-Id trailer (re-using CLAUDE_SESSION_ID) into PR body at create, add pr-owned-by-session.sh helper invoked by all destructive sites (fail-closed), add CLAUDE.md rule prohibiting destructive PR actions without ownership check. Alternative: GitHub PR labels (dso-session:<id-prefix>) for robust against body edits; tradeoff is per-repo label setup. Hybrid recommended.

FIX COMPLEXITY: COMPLEX — 6 files / 4 subsystems (scripts, skills+sub-agent prompts, CLAUDE.md policy, new helper script). Phase D Step 2 triggers: 5+ files / 3+ subsystems AND skill+script edits required AND new policy rule AND new primitive script.

PRIOR ART: Co-Authored-By trailer in commits, DSO-Story: trailer (sprint), DEFENSE_RECORD in PR comments. None currently in PR bodies.

Escalating to /dso:brainstorm per Phase D Step 2.

Brainstorm Phase 1 complete; Phase 2 in progress — paused to commit/push suggestion-record.sh fix. State to resume from:

- Approach selected: Option A — bash trailer + pr-owned-by-session.sh helper + fail-closed wrap at 6 destructive call sites + CLAUDE.md rule + CI grep test
- Marker: Session-Id: $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID + Generated-By: dso-merge-to-main-pr.sh as trailer on PR body at create
- Ownership semantics: fail-closed universally (refuse + prompt user) on foreign OR absent marker
- Session ID source: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID runtime contract — assume always set; no fallback handling
- Out of scope: GitHub labels (deferred), retro marking of existing PRs, ownership transfer
- Surface: merge-to-main-pr.sh (1 file, multiple edits); pr-owned-by-session.sh (new); debug-everything/SKILL.md, phase-10-merge-verify.md, end-session/SKILL.md (one call-site each); CLAUDE.md rule; CI grep test under plugins/dso/tests/

Pre-flight cleanup already done in this session (committed separately): suggestion-record.sh variable rename CLAUDE_SESSION_ID -> CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (the legacy var was dead code; rename + drop fallback).
